changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Add country column to vacancy table for multi-country filtering

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: UPDATE vacancy v SET country = COALESCE( (SELECT gc.country FROM geo_city gc WHERE LOWER(gc.name_en) = LOWER(v.city) LIMIT 1), (SELECT gc.country FROM geo_city gc WHERE LOWER(gc.name_uz_lat) = LOWER(v.city) LIMIT 1), (SELECT gc.country FROM geo_city gc WHERE LOWER(gc.name_ru) = LOWER(v.city) LIMIT 1), 'UZ' ) WHERE v.country IS NULL OR v.country = 'UZ';

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Index on vacancy.country for efficient filtering
